items.alt: Dr. Cray, confined to a motorized wheelchair. After we obtain a molecular sample from our own body, it seems like we're going to be cured of the alien mutagen, only for the decontamination process to fail and then Cray gets killed in an explosion when the Illuminati soldiers show up.
As we make our way deeper into the labs of Area 51, we encounter cool areas such as this anti-gravity chamber, where we must make our way across the floating debris to get to the next room.
Yep, there are flying saucers down here in Area 51. We have to enter this one to activate its weapon so we can move on, and another UFO will be used as a platform to get across a room.

This game REALLY leans into the conspiracy angle, and just about every popular conspiracy theory circa 2005 is referenced here, and that indeed includes the most famous conspiracy of all: That we faked the Moon landing and it was all recorded in a film studio. In a twist on the usual conspiracy, one of Dr. Cray's logs reveals that we DID go to the Moon, but the Apollo footage was still faked to hide what really happened once we got there. Other conspiracy theories that are referenced include the Roswell incident (of course), the JFK assassination, water fluoridation, and even the Bermuda Triangle.

Alex Jones would love this game.

As we descend even deeper into the earth beneath Area 51, we come across a scientist who will help us get past security protocols if we can clear out an Illuminati checkpoint. Upon doing so, he'll hack the security system while we hold off waves of Illuminati soldiers with another turret section.

We eventually reach a large arena-like area, and sure enough we have a boss fight against this big mutant, known as the Theta. This guy wiped out Hazmat Teams Bravo and Delta, and now we can finally get some payback. He's basically a big bullet sponge and occasionally some lesser mutant will show up to support him and annoy you.

Ethan Cole meets Edgar, an ancient and powerful Gray alien who is both the source and the cure for the alien mutagen that has spread throughout Area 51 and infected Cole. He is severely deformed and crippled, kept alive via the life-support system in his stasis tube. He communicates via telepathy by "possessing" dead bodies that Cole runs across. He is also voiced by Marilyn Manson.
Ethan Cole arrives inside the research facility in the Gray aliens' mothership buried miles below the surface at Area 51, with a group of Grays congregating behind a window to witness your arrival.

Throughout the alien facility, you'll encounter more of the Illuminati soldiers (one of the results of the "Pact" that the Illuminati made with the Grays), and the Grays themselves will enter the fray. In this scene, a Gray appears behind an energy shield and will continuously spawn Illuminati soldiers until you destroy the shield and kill the alien.

It's in the alien facility where you acquire the Meson Cannon, a weapon with powerful shots but limited ammo. In multiplayer, the Meson Cannon is a one-hit kill (and you can take yourself out if you're too close to your target) and it can clear a room if there are multiple enemies nearby.

record.text: Came back to Area 51 to continue the campaign and played about 3 hours. It looked like we'd be cured of the alien virus but it was not to be as Dr. Cray got killed. Plus, we finally meet the Grays, the classic aliens associated with Area 51. See alt text for details. #gaming #videogames #xbox
